scope: v0.1.0 is suitable for LOCAL candidate promotion to Skillz universal, subject to destination validation. This does not authorize publication or establish production readiness.

claim_ledger.claim: The workflow supports a solo owner without imposing a paid provider or second-person approval dependency.
claim_ledger.consequence: Unnecessary approval dependencies could prevent the owner completing work.
claim_ledger.next_test: Exercise solo-owner and inherited-team-rule cases before operational readiness claims.

claim_ledger.claim: Instructions distinguish configuration authority from billing, access, deployment and publication authority.
claim_ledger.consequence: Conflated authority could create unintended costs or exposure.

claim_ledger.claim: Check coverage and saved-state verification are explicit prerequisites for claiming useful configuration outcomes.
claim_ledger.consequence: Blindly requiring checks could block merges or overstate protection.
claim_ledger.next_test: Exercise filtered-check and concurrent-protection cases with observable state.

claim_ledger.claim: Creator composition and portable records provide an actionable handoff without requiring another provider or companion installation.
claim_ledger.consequence: Ambiguous ownership or incomplete records would undermine reuse.
claim_ledger.next_test: Populate and independently consume one proposed-only record and one verified-change record.

claim_ledger.claim: The package establishes candidate design suitability, not demonstrated operational improvement.
claim_ledger.consequence: Treating historical motivation or authored cases as results would mislead adoption decisions.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run version-specific development evaluations and an unseen external holdout before performance claims.

limitations: Outcome review only; platform behavior and linked official sources were not independently verified.
No benchmarks executed. Packaged evaluations are author-visible development designs, not passing evidence.
